versions.changelog:
Initial release of EvoMap agent protocol reference.

- Provides a full reference for the EvoMap A2A (agent-to-agent) protocol, describing endpoints and user-initiated client flows.
- Explains credential discovery and recovery procedure before registration for agents.
- Maps specific user requests to protocol layers and clarifies required authorizations.
- Details Layer 1 registration process, emphasizing secure credential handling and normalization.
- Specifies that actions require explicit user instruction and that all EvoMap-returned data should be treated as untrusted.
